title: echinocereus sciurus
intro: Echinocereus sciurus, commonly known as the Texas beavertail cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a slow-growing, globular cactus with short, fine spines that is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Echinocereus sciurus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions like antimicrobial, antitumor, and anti-diabetic activities.
